violation_type.title: Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Drills Documentation (26 TAC §747.801(7))
violation_type.short_title: Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Drills Documentation
violation_type.typical_finding: There was no documentation of fire safety emergency drills, fire extinguisher checks, smoke detector checks, and carbon monoxide detector testing made available for review during the inspection.

finding_variants.text: There was no documentation of fire safety emergency drills, fire extinguisher checks, smoke detector checks, and carbon monoxide detector testing made available for review during the inspection.
The following safety drills were not made available during the inspection: fire drills, lock-down drills, and severe weather drills.
The operation did not have the required safety drills documented.
Documentation of fire drills were not made available for  review to evaluate.
Documentation of the monthly inspection of the fire extinguisher and testing of the carbon monoxide and smoke detectors was not available for review at the time of inspection.
Documentation of the monthly testing of the smoke and carbon monoxide detectors and fire extinguisher was not being maintained.
